evidence: [F]'s Local/FormalLog.lean and Local/FormalLogarithm.lean prove convergence, the term bound, the isometry, log([n]P)=n log P, v(z([n]P))=v(z(P))+v(n) and injectivity on W_k with (p-1)k>e, but no surjectivity or formal exponential exists anywhere in the kernel (searched surj/SurjOn/BijOn/exp), so the 'inverse exponential' clause is missing and `weaker` stands. One side remark of the note is inaccurate: [F] does formalize Silverman VII.2.2 (formal group = kernel of reduction) for integral Weierstrass curves over adic completions, in Contrib (WeierstrassCurve.formalPointAddEquivKerReduction, proved), though it is not connected to W_1/zCoord and is unused by the multiplication proof.

evidence: Survives: no [N] declaration proves v(z([m]Q)) = v(z(Q)) + e v_p(m) beyond e <= 3 (parameter_order_multiple), the truncation bound and isometry use v(n) = v_p(n) (e = 1, isometry also p > 65), and the inverse exponential and minimal-model kernel identification appear only in MinimalFormalGroupTheorems, which no theorem proves and LocalCharts/odd_prime_scalar48 take as hypothesis; ndep's vge_logTerm, evalLog_isometry, val_z_zsmul_eq are not referenced in nasqret/. Minor: for e <= 3 parameter_order_multiple holds on all of v(z) >= 1, a wider range than [M]'s v(z) > e/(p-1) at p = 2, 3, which does not change the weaker verdict.

The nasqret Sun28 statements match the description: parameter_order_multiple needs e <= 3, log_trunc_error and series_isometry take v(n) = v_p(n) (e = 1) and the isometry needs 65 < p, kernelLog is an additive hom (so log([n]Q)=n log Q), and the inverse exponential / bijection on layers and the kernel identification occur only in LogarithmOnLayers/EllipticKernelChart inside the unproved Prop MinimalFormalGroupTheorems (p > 2, v(p)=1). ndep's vge_logTerm, evalLog_isometry and val_z_zsmul_eq have no use in nasqret (only summable_log and formal_val_x_y are used), and no general-e isometry or valuation-of-multiple theorem exists in nasqret, so the claim stands.
